subject: Re: Kickoff: cell painting embedding service (H1)
body:
Lucia,

Staffing: Maren 50% (pipeline + weights loading), Giannis 40% (batch API), Amara 30% (eval harness hookup with Tomas's Evalline team). That covers parity and the API milestone.

Compute is light — inference only, so best-effort Titan A100 slices are fine; I'm asking for 32 GPUs peak during plate batch tests. No Vulcan reservation needed.

One scheduling constraint to flag: our imaging tables need to move to Corpus v2 before the migration freeze. Jun's team freezes Corpus v2 migrations on 2026-06-26, so the BBBC025-derived tables have to be fully migrated by mid-June or we are stuck on v1 for the rest of the year. I've put the migration work in Amara's plan for May.

Will have a written plan in the doc by Thursday.

Jelena
